description: Vozni red autobusa na području Općine Gorjani is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Općina Gorjani. Bus schedule in Gorjani Municipality. Coverage: Općina Gorjani. The portal shows the English title as "Bus schedule in Gorjani Municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Općina Gorjani. Its keywords include vozni red. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
